cases.reason: Link-Type descriptors prohibit the Bead-only ownership member, including an explicitly empty one.
A direct declaration requires the exact parent revision; a URI-only parent is not a selected default request.
Null is not an omitted object-or-Boolean properties schema.
Recorded mode must retain an actual declaration Link revision; labels and row numbers cannot supply one.
Definition category follows its metatype affiliation; describes is a prohibited descriptor field.

additional_authored_counterexamples.reason: A numeric value is not an opaque string revision token.
Whole References use uri, never id in place of uri.
An opaque Resource revision is not necessarily a SemVer author label.
Different editorial names cannot bypass the current uniqueItems ownership rule.
The obsolete field is refused rather than silently translated to unique.
The opaque resource arm contains only resourceKind; scope/types are not allowed.
A captured declaration's source identity must be the containing definition; a pin is not an ownership witness.
